name: io.github.uiverify/uiverify
description: UI Verify MCP server for visual regression testing: your coding agent (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex) pulls a pull request's UI changes into the conversation, views each visual diff, reads the AI judge's verdict, and accepts the intended baselines - all over MCP.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token: your UIVERIFY_API_KEY from your uiverify.ai project setup page.
